governance.parent: Department of Culture of Voronezh Oblast
controls: approval of programme, loans or disposals by a ministry or council

basis: The museum's charter (a scan on its documents page) names it a state budgetary institution of Voronezh Oblast whose founder's powers are exercised by the regional Department of Culture, which approves its financial plan and agrees disposals of valuable property (sections 1, 5.11 and 6).

The festival's about page says the charitable foundation OMK-Uchastie runs it with OMK, and the foundation's about page says it was founded on the initiative of OMK's owners and lists OMK as founder; the form given is that of the organising foundation.

governance.parent: Department of Culture of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg

basis: The museum's information page names it a municipal autonomous cultural institution and gives the Department of Culture of the city administration as its founder.

governance.parent: Administration of the President of the Russian Federation

basis: Federal Law No. 68-FZ of 13 May 2008 (articles 2, 4, 11 to 14) makes a presidential centre a foundation created by the Presidential Administration, which approves the board of trustees' membership; the board appoints the executive director and the management board signs staff labour contracts; the centre's about page says it was created under this law.

Presidential Order N° 082/01 of 28/08/2020 (Official Gazette Special of 04/09/2020, articles 2, 5, 8 and 31) establishes the Rwanda Cultural Heritage Academy as a non-commercial public institution under the culture ministry audited by the Auditor General, and its visit page lists the Rwanda Art Museum among the Academy's museums.

The Royal Commission for AlUla annual report 2024 says it was established by Royal Decree No. A/296 of 2017 and has a board chaired by the Crown Prince, and the Desert X page says Arts AlUla was created within the Commission.
